verdict.line: You lose if you trade beside your own spirit or feed Tentacles near walls; you win if you isolate skirmishes on open ground and land W into your Deathbringer Stance.

brief.thesis: This matchup is a positioning puzzle built around Illaoi's E (Test of Spirit): stand still next to the ripped spirit and its echo doubles the damage you take, but drift too far and you become a Vessel that spawns her a permanent Tentacle. Aatrox's Umbral Dash is the one tool with the tempo to sit in that narrow safe band. The measured data backs this up — 49.5% win rate over 653 games with a solo-kill edge to Aatrox — so neither side has a structural stranglehold; the lane is decided by who manages the tether correctly.

theirWindow.when: She lands Test of Spirit near walls
theirWindow.what: Immediately move off the spirit rather than trading beside it — the echo means every point of damage it takes is mirrored onto you, so standing still to fight there doubles what you eat.

yourWindow.what: Land W (Infernal Chains) to force her to flee the impact zone or take it twice, then follow with Q swings and your empowered auto; World Ender's healing boost and Umbral Dash's on-hit heal let you outlast her Tentacle sustain in the extended trade.

powerCurve.note: Test of Spirit online, respect tether

start.why: Run in 76.1% of games at 48.3% win rate over 632 games — the extra sustain and AD keep you even through her Harsh Lesson pokes before Umbral Dash's heal comes online at meaningful values.

boots.why: 78.9% pick rate at 48% win rate over 590 games — Illaoi's damage is entirely physical basic attacks and Tentacle procs, so the flat reduction blunts both her Harsh Lesson leaps and passive Tentacle swings.

core.why: First item in the top-performing build path (51.4% win rate, 37 games); the shield proc absorbs a Tentacle Smash or Harsh Lesson hit during your all-in window.
Second item on the same path; the on-hit heal and proc stack with Umbral Dash's healing to win extended trades against her Tentacle sustain.
Closes out the highest-performing build path; damage-over-time conversion keeps you alive through delayed Tentacle and Test of Spirit echo damage.

situational.when: her tentacles and Harsh Lesson leaps are healing her back up in extended fights
you need armor shred to force through her early build
the game runs long and you're ahead on cooldown tempo
the enemy team stacks hard CC that would lock you out of your Umbral Dash window

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacking adaptive force through repeated Q and W trades gives you the sustained damage and healing to win the skirmishes that decide this even matchup, rather than relying on a single burst window.

summoners.why: Run in 86.4% of games at 48% win rate — Ignite's grievous wounds directly cuts the healing Illaoi gets from Tentacle procs and Harsh Lesson connects, matching OP.GG's own tip for this matchup.

playing.title: Poke wide of walls
playing.detail: Tentacles spawn only on nearby impassible terrain, so fight in open lane space to deny her the extra swings and the healing those swings give her on champion hits.

playing.title: Track your Deathbringer Stance
playing.detail: Trade when the empowered auto is up — its bonus magic damage and max-health heal are what let you win a straight damage race against her.

playing.title: Never trade beside your spirit
playing.detail: If she rips your spirit with E (Test of Spirit, 16/15/14/13/12s cooldown), don't stand and fight next to it — the spirit echoes a percentage of damage dealt to it back onto you, so trading in place doubles what you take.

playing.title: Respect the Vessel threshold
playing.detail: If you retreat too far from the spirit before it expires, you become a Vessel that spawns Tentacles for her — use Umbral Dash's short cooldown (9/8/7/6/5s) to hold the exact middle distance instead of sprinting away.

playing.title: Land W to lock fights
playing.detail: Infernal Chains damages the first enemy hit and forces them to leave the impact area quickly or take it again — use it to punish her short-range Harsh Lesson leap before she can reset distance.

playing.title: All-in hard after level 6
playing.detail: World Ender's bonus AD, increased healing, Move Speed, and minion fear paired with Umbral Dash's on-hit heal make this your strongest forced-fight window, and it lines up with your measured solo-kill edge in this matchup.

playing.title: Buy grievous wounds early
playing.detail: Illaoi's Tentacles and Harsh Lesson leaps heal her whenever they connect on a champion, so Ignite early and Executioner's Calling later directly cut that sustain — this is OP.GG's own stated tip for the matchup.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG game data on the current patch (16.18.1); the tactical reasoning tying them to specific ability cooldowns and windows is my own read of the matchup.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid Illaoi’s (E) while facing her. Purchase items that reduce healing and maintain some distance to use your abilities to when fighting her.
